run_kmeans_plusplus_init: run kmeans_plusplus to generate initial cluster seeds for k-means clustering from sample data
run_make_blobs: run make_blobs to generate synthetic blob data with specified number of samples and centers
build_kmeans_plusplus_example: build a k-means++ initialization example with scatter plot visualization of cluster seeds
run_scatter_plot: run matplotlib scatter plot to visualize sample data points and k-means++ cluster centers
test_kmeans_plusplus: test kmeans_plusplus with make_blobs data and verify returned center coordinates and indices
